title_en: Fall 2026 Grading Option Selection for Major Courses of Other Departments: Application
summary: The department announces the application period for the Fall 2026 grading option selection system for major courses offered by other departments (schools), covering 1,424 courses from 16 colleges. The notice text itself does not state the application dates, the eligibility rules or the application method. These are given in the attached guideline, which was not read, so students should read the attachment and the linked course list.
conditions: The application period, eligibility and procedure are not given in the notice text; they appear in the attached guideline, which was not read.
Only the 1,424 courses from 16 colleges in the linked spreadsheet are listed as covered by this system.
steps: Read the attached guideline, "[붙임] 2026학년도 2학기 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제 안내문 (Guidelines for Changing Grading Option of Undergraduat...)", for the application period, eligibility and procedure. Its content was not read for this translation.
Check the linked course list (Google Sheets) to confirm whether your course is one of the 1,424 eligible courses.
Apply within the period and by the method stated in the attached guideline. For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
